# Rethinking Modern Risk: How AML Compliance Powers Growth


October 14, 2026


#### Highlights:


-


**Streamlining Regulatory Compliance:** Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Compliance Solutions from Equifax ease the regulatory burden for financial institutions and related industries by identifying high-risk prospect connections before money laundering activities disrupt enterprise operations.


-


**Proven Enterprise & Scale:** Equifax reviewed 32 million subscriber accounts to uncover just 17 true risks for a global telecommunications provider, eliminating tens of thousands of hours of manual review for the customer.


-


**Demonstrated Operational Efficiency:** Agentic AI Triage and cloud-native matching achieve an 85 percent reduction in false positives and an 80 percent decrease in alert handling times.


Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance strategies have evolved beyond simple administrative tasks to essential components of customer due diligence practices. Modern regulatory expectations demand real-time operational effectiveness rather than periodic, manual checks. Organizations that integrate continuous monitoring across the customer lifecycle eliminate onboarding friction, reduce false positives, and build sustainable trust with valid customers. To help organizations navigate these shifting expectations,[Equifax expanded its AML Compliance Solutions](https://investor.equifax.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1378/equifax-assists-regulated-businesses-with-aml-compliance) in November 2025, adding advanced Watchlist and Adverse Media Screening capabilities alongside continuous transaction monitoring to ease the compliance burden.


#### The Changing Economics of Risk


The financial consequences of regulatory inaction remain high, with recent global enforcement actions triggering more than $1.3 billion in penalties.¹ Because the United States accounts for 25% of the $300 billion in annual global money laundering risk, automated defenses are an operational necessity.² Equifax is assisting regulated businesses with automated defense through AML Compliance solutions designed to ease the burden of anti-money laundering regulatory compliance for financial services firms and related industries by flagging potential associations between a prospect and activities that may indicate potential money laundering.


Legacy compliance models rely on fragmented workflows, manual reviews, and static databases. These siloed systems can generate massive false-positive rates that disrupt onboarding, alienate valuable customers, and drain operational resources. To protect market share and drive top-line expansion, enterprise leaders across both financial and non-financial sectors, such as telecommunications and automotive services, are rethinking how regulatory due diligence fits into their overall growth strategies.


#### Real-World Impact: Hybrid Intelligence at Scale


Deploying a hybrid compliance model delivers transformational efficiency for organizations across every industry. By combining intelligent matching engines with expert human compliance analysts who apply client-specific business rules, Equifax provides customers with scalable risk intelligence, reduced false positives, and transparent audit trails.


This hybrid approach demonstrated effective results for a major telecommunications provider managing tens of millions of domestic and international subscribers:


-


Screening at enterprise scale: Continuous screening was executed across an initial database of 32 million subscriber accounts.


-


Precision automated filtering: Advanced cloud-native algorithms narrowed those 32 million records down to fewer than 80,000 flagged accounts.


-


Actionable risk output: Dedicated compliance analysts evaluated those 80,000 flags, delivering just 17 final alerts to the client as true, actionable risks.


By partnering with Equifax, the enterprise eliminated tens of thousands of manual review hours, speeding up customer approvals while preserving internal resources.


[Learn more about the technology behind this shift and how modern data structures transform fraud prevention.](https://www.equifax.com/business/identity-fraud/)


#### Protecting the Full Customer Lifecycle


Effective modern compliance strategies extend seamlessly from initial customer application through active account management. Operational resilience requires continuous protection that adapts as customer relationships evolve. Growth starts at acquisition, and confirming a user's identity at the outset establishes a baseline of trust before running secondary matching algorithms, removing the false-positive noise that delays account opening.


#### Frictionless Onboarding and Screening


For regulated organizations, navigating the complexities of AML laws can be a constant, costly, and high-stakes endeavor. The[Watchlist and Adverse Media solution](https://www.equifax.com/business/product/watchlist-and-adverse-media/) empowers teams to perform essential customer due diligence with confidence, transforming the burden of compliance into a streamlined, efficient process. The solution offers access to more than 150 sanctions and watchlists and 30,000 adverse news sources globally through a single platform. Powered by[EFX.AI](https://www.equifax.com/about-equifax/efx-ai/) , conceptual vector matching resolves typos, linguistic nuances, and cultural naming conventions for more than 100 languages. The result is a seamless onboarding experience backed by clear, audit-ready reporting to satisfy strict regulatory standards.


Post-onboarding monitoring is often where compliance costs surge due to alert fatigue and delayed system updates. Transaction Monitoring delivers continuous surveillance to flag account takeovers or unusual activity. Rather than waiting weeks on engineering sprints, risk teams gain code-free control to adjust thresholds and backtest rules against live traffic. Driven by Agentic AI Triage, the system builds investigation narratives, streamlines Suspicious Activity Report e-filing, and compiles audit-ready documentation. As a result, the system delivers an 85% reduction in false positives and an 80% decrease in alert handling times, freeing internal teams to focus on growth.³


#### Transforming Compliance into a Competitive Advantage


Compliance management no longer needs to be seen as an administrative burden. By shifting from point-in-time reviews to a continuous lifecycle model powered by EFX.AI and expert human oversight, organizations can safeguard their portfolios while delivering a seamless user experience. Embracing an integrated approach transforms regulatory mandates into a powerful engine for long-term growth.


**Sources:**
¹ Benchmark tracked by global compliance watchdogs like Fines Watch and official enforcement press releases from FinCEN, the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), and the Department of Justice (DOJ).


² United States Department of the Treasury (specifically their National Money Laundering Risk Assessment) and the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC).


³Transaction Monitoring service and its data provided in partnership with Unit21.
